description: GX-FIX-forge-rate (D-070): event kinds stored in the local file log (forge-events.local_log_dir) whatever forge-events.adapter is. High-volume measurement kinds (one per test or step) never become issue comments; a reader of the port sees both logs of a channel. GX-25: gate.started is file-routed too, because a gate run is already at its bound of GitHub writes (gate.forge_writes_per_run_max); one key moves it back to the forge.
